thread:
morgan: Heads-up: we're seeing a bunch of support tickets from bookmarks after last week's IA regroup. How should the console handle deep-links into moved items? Do we auto-redirect, keep the old URL visible, or show an intermediate landing?

tara: Preserve link reliability is top priority. Proposed UX: resolve on load, expand the new folder, visually highlight the item, and show a small non-modal banner: "Moved: This item now lives in Assets > Models. We'll keep this link working. [Read why]". Banner should dismiss per-user.

devin: Router plan: attempt direct match -> alias registry -> canonical route. Alias registry is a JSON in infra with pattern params. We can choose between history.replaceState(canonical) vs keeping original URL. I lean toward keeping original to avoid breaking external docs, but update breadcrumb to canonical.

alex: Design preference: keep the browser URL unchanged for transparency, but always show canonical breadcrumb and a muted pill: "(moved)"
